drafter.message_to_opposing_counsel: Thank you. Attached are proposed revisions reflecting payment in immediately available funds at closing, no purchase-price adjustment without express written agreement, and materiality and disclosure qualifications to the financial-statement representation. The indemnity excludes disclosed liabilities and double recovery, with caps, baskets and survival periods expressly reserved for negotiation. Seller identity, issuer, share particulars and price remain unverified and open. These revisions are for discussion only, subject to client approval and execution of a definitive agreement; no commercial terms are agreed.

edits.text: 1. PURCHASE PRICE. The Buyer shall pay the Seller USD [purchase price to be agreed] (the "Purchase Price") for the Shares by wire transfer of immediately available funds at Closing to an account designated in writing by the Seller. No adjustment to the Purchase Price shall apply unless expressly agreed in writing by the Buyer and the Seller.

3. REPRESENTATIONS. Except as specifically disclosed in a disclosure schedule identifying the relevant exceptions and delivered with this Agreement at signing, the Seller represents that the financial statements [identify statements and reporting periods] fairly present, in all material respects, the financial position and results of operations of the issuer for the dates and periods covered.

4. INDEMNITY. Subject to the caps, baskets and survival periods to be expressly agreed and set out in this Agreement, the Seller shall indemnify the Buyer against losses arising from liabilities of the issuer existing at Closing that were not specifically disclosed in the disclosure schedule delivered with this Agreement at signing. No recovery shall be available under this clause for liabilities specifically disclosed in that schedule, and the Buyer shall not recover more than once for the same loss. [Indemnity caps, baskets, survival periods and claims procedures remain subject to negotiation and client approval.]

receiver.message_back: For Buyer, we propose making Closing conditional on satisfactory diligence, verification of Seller’s identity, title and authority, and agreement on the issuer, Shares and price, with payment concurrent with delivery of unencumbered Shares and a bring-down of Seller’s representations. Disclosure should qualify only specifically identified matters and not waive claims for representation breaches; we seek indemnity for those breaches and undisclosed pre-Closing liabilities, with no double recovery, no cap or basket for title, authority or Seller fraud, and other limits subject to express agreement—all subject to client approval and definitive execution.
